amendment_reason: replace creation-time enrollment semantics with first-scheduled-observation semantics before T0 (pre-enrollment amendment; PF0D-time hash retained in history, this file is the binding enrollment rule)
amended_by: PF0E pre-T0 audit; PF0D commit 2f537a2 holds the superseded version

h2.t0: UTC time of the init_baseline run, performed after the PF0E tool and this rules file are frozen, committed and pushed; no retroactive enrollment
h2.enrollment_time_source: external ledger first_seen_at (works.created_at is not schema-protected and is not used as the enrollment time)
h2.population: works not in the baseline identity set (all work ids existing at T0) that are observed with evidence_class = live at a scheduled observation after T0
h2.removal_or_dropout: FORBIDDEN (labels, manual correction, matched/locked, matcher output changes never remove a unit)
h2.dedup: against H1, C5c.5 units and past GT by work identity; applied at enrollment only, never re-applied
h2.inclusion_rule: deterministic: every population work, ordered by work id; no discretionary selection
h2.input_snapshot: canonical hash of evaluation-input identity and matcher-input fields captured at enrollment
h2.ledger: external audit-side, append-only, hash-chained tranche commitments; production DB receives no membership data
h2.isolation: enrolled units are excluded from ordinary development, GT and tuning; no backflow
h2.gt_review: blind review of the full H2 membership under one protocol, after machine output is frozen; machine state hidden from reviewers; reviewer capacity for 946 units is a feasibility requirement
h2.slow_accumulation: wait; monthly count-only census allowed (new entries, cumulative enrolled, remaining to target); never relax thresholds, target or population; no post-hoc additions
h2.enrollment_event: the first scheduled observation after T0 at which a non-baseline work is observed in the target live population

cadence.missed_scheduled_run: recorded as a missed record; never backfilled

h2.same_run_overflow: when one run has more candidates than remaining capacity, enrol by ascending work id up to 946 and close the tranche (deterministic, performance-independent)
h2.baseline_identity: works.id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, never reused); baseline fixes works_sequence; a non-baseline work with id <= baseline works_sequence, or a decreasing works_sequence, stops the run
h2.checkpoint_chain: independent of the ledger directory; per successful run: record_count, ledger_head_sha256, works_sequence, enrollment_rule_sha256, tool sha/head, previous checkpoint sha; the next run reads previous values from it; chain head is frozen in the audit freeze

pf0c_policy_unchanged.note: sample_size block in pr4_final_policy.json (H2=573, H1 included) is superseded for sizing by this file; statistical thresholds unchanged
